verdict.rationale: Proa is a Rust web framework that is driven through code and a CLI. The evidence never describes a product UI, a management API, or parity between the two. A probe found an openapi.json at proa.so, but nothing shows what that API covers or that it matches any UI capability, so the axis is treated as applicable but unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
